title: Chesapeake Bay Fishing Charters
blurb: Tenacious Fishing Charters offers fishing trips for species like Striped Bass, Bluefish, Spanish Mackerel, Cobia, Red Drum, Spot, Perch, Croakers, and Catfish. They operate from Deale, MD, with trips also from Annapolis and Solomons. They provide family charters, corporate charters, crabbing charters, dinner cruises, crab feasts, and special event cruises.
extraNote: Slipped at Happy Harbor Restaurant, Deale, MD · Mid-April through December
